question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Players, Humans, Students

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edd9b38d8ef7661371c9f13ec1a7413d2b4d4e4df1df506f9494ab28f5100ca0.png]
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given relation is as follows :-

 
• All Players are humans.
 
• All Students are humans
 
• Some Students may be players and vice-versa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6061d303499dac02f7147b442584817de5995fc97aede2342b4c99d0351c17b.png] 

∴ Here, figure 2 represents the given relation.

Hence, the correct answer is** "2".**
